evidence.title: AI is impacting what California students chose to study, report says

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report release record
occurrences.quote_span: The 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report was released in October and captures how Californians feel about postsecondary education, the value of a degree, and AI.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures survey methodology
occurrences.quote_span: The findings are based on web surveys from February and March
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: However, Californians are nearly evenly split on how AI will affect their jobs: “36% of adults believe the impact of AI will be positive, and 37% believe it will be negative,” according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: the report
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: The report also found that 32% of students believe AI will have a “great impact” on their future jobs, and 36% said it’ll have “some impact.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: Over half of California college students say that the rise of artificial intelligence has impacted their decision on what to study, new research has found.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: The report also found that 32% of students believe AI will have a “great impact” on their future jobs, and 36% said it’ll have “some impact.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: More than half of California adult students are using AI regularly for their schoolwork — 20% use it daily and 35% use it weekly, according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: the report
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: More than half of California adult students are using AI regularly for their schoolwork — 20% use it daily and 35% use it weekly, according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: the report
occurrences.subject: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 State of California Learners Gallup and College Futures report
occurrences.quote_span: It found that 55% of California adult students — people pursuing a degree or a certificate — reported AI had at least “some impact” on the program of study they selected.
